beginning.line: It said there are no new beginnings
beginning.linePrev: I felt it clawing at my clothes like a grieving friend
beginning.lineNext: Until everybody sees that the old ways need to end

winning.line: I took up all of my winnings
stanza: I took up all of my winnings
And I gave my little Bessie half
She tore it up and threw it in my face
Now there's one thing in the whole wide world
I sure would like to see
That's when that little love of mine
Dips her doughnut in my tea
